- Validate input: if dict is empty, return False; iterate keys ensuring each is str; if any non-str key exists, return False.
- Determine case: check two flags all_lower = all(k.islower() for keys), all_upper = all(k.isupper() for keys); note islower/upper require at least one cased char, so ensure keys contain at least one alphabetic character (e.g., any(c.isalpha() for c in k)) or treat non-cased strings as failing both.
- Return True if all_lower or all_upper is True; otherwise return False.
